messages:
Emma (CSE): fwd from AcmeCorp - they're seeing Dedicated allocation failures and huge tail latency since ~08:10 UTC. customer report: 503s on text-generation calls and occasional 429s.
AcmeCorp - John: @emma here are logs — calls fail with 'alloc error' and then a fallback to hosted which spikes cost. sample error: `{"code":503,"message":"no available capacity in requested region"}`
Emma (CSE): repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/dedicated/generate with model `rwd-dedicated-v2` 2) concurrency ~120 clients, seq len 512, streaming disabled 3) observe 503 + increased p95 latency ~1.2s -> 4-5s then fallback to hosted.
OpsBot: automatically failed over 17 requests from `na-west2` -> `na-east1` at 2024-11-09T08:12:07Z due to allocator:capacity_shortage (policy: region-preference).
Maria (Oncall): @Kevin / @Anjali can you pull allocator logs and autoscaler events for na-west2 between 08:05-08:15? also need the customer's dedicated pool id and reserved capacity settings.
Kevin (Infra): grabbing logs now. snippet from allocator at 08:11:59: ```allocator: allocation failed: region=na-west2 reason=no_free_gpu_pool candidate_pools=[dedicated-na-west2-large,dedicated-na-west2-small] pending=23 reserved=2``` Seeing repeated placement retries and evictions due to host-level OOMs.
Kevin (Infra): also seeing sustained GPU fragmentations: many pods with partially-used GPUs causing bin-packing failures. tagging noisy-tenant detection for tenant-id `t-9876`.
Anjali (SRE): noisy neighbor + fragmentation fits. quick mitigation options: 1) bump reserved pool for affected customers by 2 GPUs (temp) 2) trigger aggressive defragmentation (drain + binpack) 3) apply per-tenant concurrency cap until autoscaler stabilizes. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-capacity-failover
Anjali (SRE): command to bump reserved pool (example): ```rwdctl reserved update --pool dedicated-na-west2 --customer t-1234 --add 2 --reason "temp-mitigation/noisy-tenant-08Nov"```
Maria (Oncall): Emma, can you confirm AcmeCorp's pool id and whether they have a reserved commitment? we should avoid accidental double-charging.
Emma (CSE): AcmeCorp (t-1234) has reserved=0 on this pool; they are on Dedicated per-usage. they reported surprise at being routed to hosted and higher invoicing. passed Billing ticket to finance: #BILL-1352.
BillingBot: noticed billing spike for customer t-1234 between 08:12-08:18: used hosted fallback compute at rate multiplier x1.8; auto-flagged and opened internal ticket BILL-1352.
Kevin (Infra): short-term: I'm going to cordon two noisy nodes and migrate their pods to burstable pool; will run defrag while mig occurs. ETA 12-15 mins.
Anjali (SRE): also recommend adjusting autoscaler thresholds — current scale-up cooldown=120s which is too long under sudden hotspot. propose temp cooldown=30s for na-west2. command: ```k8s-scalecfg set autoscaler.na-west2.cooldown 30s --reason "hotspot-11Nov-temp"```
Emma (CSE): customer affected pages SRE team; they're asking for ETA and whether we can force-route their traffic to na-east1 now while infra mitigates.
Maria (Oncall): we can apply a route override for t-1234 to prefer na-east1 for 1 hour. that avoids further host churn in na-west2. I'll need ops approval.
Kevin (Infra): approved. applying route override: ```rwdctl routes set --customer t-1234 --preferred-region na-east1 --ttl 3600```
OpsBot: route override applied for t-1234 -> na-east1 (TTL 3600s) by Maria (Oncall) at 2024-11-09T08:14:22Z.
Emma (CSE): communicated to customer: temporary route to na-east1 + refund review for excess hosted charges. they asked for post-mortem and capacity timeline.
Anjali (SRE): follow-ups: - run defrag and monitor allocator failure rate (goal <1% failed allocations) - review autoscaler cooldown and instance profile for na-west2 - investigate tenant t-9876 noisy patterns and throttle or isolate if repeated
Maria (Oncall): marking P1 incident and assigning to Kevin and Anjali. I'll update incident channel and create incident doc. next update in 10m or sooner if changes. :rotating_light:
Emma (CSE): thanks all — will keep customer updated.
AcmeCorp - John: thanks team — appreciate the quick help, please keep us posted. :pray:
